Now today they are warning of another storm as destructive as the last. I can only remember two times in the last ~25 years having a tornado warning...and now two within a month. Meteorologically, what gives? Unusually bad summer or will this continue happening in the future?
Why have there been so many tornado warnings in New Jersey lately?

"The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change stated in its 2007 assessment that 'various extreme events are very likely to change in magnitude and/or frequency and location with global warming.'
